title: Can this branch still beat the best?
hook: An optimistic bound can make a whole branch unnecessary.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Search trees; minimax and a partial solution state.
doesNotKnow: Prune a knapsack search branch using a fractional optimistic upper bound on its possible value.

misconception: A currently low-value partial choice can always be discarded.
objective: Prune a knapsack search branch using a fractional optimistic upper bound on its possible value.

claims.text: Allowing fractions supplies an optimistic bound for every completion of a branch. Once that bound cannot beat a feasible incumbent, the branch can be discarded; supplying a stronger feasible incumbent changes the work, not the optimal value.
